subject: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path

Hi Sonia —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight mutual action plan that ties together the technical acceptance gates, procurement milestones, and the billing path for the private offer (AWS Marketplace preferred; GCP private offer as fallback).

High-level asks from you:
- Confirm procurement owner + PO cadence (invoice vs. marketplace invoice)
- Technical acceptance window: can you commit to a 10 business-day acceptance after we hand over the acceptance checklist?
- Any legal constraints around data residency or SOC 2 artifacts we should add to the MAP?

I attached a draft MAP (Helio_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a minimal SOW so procurement can see line items. Proposed milestones are intentionally short so we can align with your Q2 close targets:
1) MAP signoff (procurement + legal) — target 2027-04-20
2) Technical kickoff + dataset onboarding — target 2027-04-26
3) Acceptance run & performance evaluation (10 bd) — target 2027-05-10
4) Marketplace private-offer activation or direct invoice start — target 2027-05-12

Billing path options (summary):
- Option A (recommended): AWS Private Offer via AWS Marketplace. Helio provides marketplace billing info, Redwood issues usage invoices to AWS for marketplace settlement. Faster procurement path for customers already using AWS.
- Option B: GCP private-offer in parallel (fallback) — useful if procurement requires GCP commitments or if AWS Marketplace approval delays occur.
- Option C: Direct invoicing with net-30 (requires revenue ops approval; potential delay on provisioning).

I left placeholders in the MAP for the procurement contact and PO number. If you prefer, we can route final commercial paperwork through HubSpot and DocuSign — I added links in the doc.

Attaching: Helio_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates), Helio_SOW_draft.pdf (line items + billing options).

Would you be available for a 30-minute MAP review tomorrow at 10am PT?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0126

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement: procurement@heliohealth.com will own the PO. We typically prefer marketplace billing but need confirmation that AWS will accept the private offer without separate security questionnaires pending.
- Legal: SOC 2 Type II report is required; is that something you can share? Also need standard DPAs and data processing addendum.
- Timeline: the team is aiming for a May 15 activation but dependent on legal review.

Can we do the MAP review tomorrow at 10am PT. I'll loop in our procurement manager in the call invite.

Best,
Sonia
Director of Product, HelioHealth
sonia.patel@heliohealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. Notes on your points:

- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II attest and our security questionnaire answers. Karthik, can you attach the SOC 2 bundle and the security survey template?
- Marketplace acceptance: AWS Private Offers typically accept the offer if the buyer org is enrolled; there is sometimes a 3–5 business day review window for vendor accounts. We recommend initiating the private offer flow now in parallel with SOW review to avoid delays.
- Legal: we'll start a slim DPA that references your requirements — Marissa will draft the DPA and SOW redlines.

I updated the MAP to include a parallel acceptance track:
- If AWS Marketplace private-offer approval completes before legal finalization, we can provision a guarded, short-lived activation for your acceptance tests and transition to full production after contract signature.
- If AWS is delayed, we'll pursue GCP private-offer lane in parallel; that helps keep your internal cloud procurement options open.

Attaching: Helio_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with parallel track) — please pull that into the shared invite so procurement can annotate.

See you tomorrow at 10am PT.

—Aditya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 12:41 PM Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement/legal side:
> 
> - Procurement: procurement@heliohealth.com will own the PO. We typically prefer marketplace billing but need confirmation that AWS will accept the private offer without separate security questionnaires pending.

Hi all — attaching the SOC2 bundle and our completed vendor security survey. The SOC2 PDF includes the coverage dates and scope. Two small clarifications for procurement:

1) If Helio elects AWS Private Offer, the first invoice cycle will come through AWS Marketplace (Helio will see charges on their AWS bill). Redwood will invoice AWS for usage and AWS pays Redwood per marketplace settlement timing. That route avoids Redwood sending a direct invoice to Helio and typically accelerates payment.
2) If Helio requests direct invoicing instead, RevOps requires net-30 terms and a signed SOW before provisioning non-marketplace accounts. That path can delay activation by ~7–10 business days for billing setup.

Files attached: SOC2_Redwood_2026_TypeII.pdf, Redwood_SecuritySurvey_2027.xlsx

—Karthik
Director, Applied ML Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@heliohealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private offer onramp checkpoints — HelioHealth MAP and billing path

Appreciate the docs and the call yesterday. Procurement confirmed they will attempt the AWS Marketplace private-offer route first. A few next steps from our side:

- Procurement will submit a marketplace private-offer request by EOD Wed 2027-04-14 (procurement@heliohealth.com).
- Legal will circle back with redlines on the DPA by 2027-04-18.
- Helio engineering will complete the acceptance tests within the 10-business-day window once we have the temporary activation.

We'll update the HubSpot deal (HS-5923) with the PO and expected activation date. If marketplace registration stalls beyond 5 bd, we will trigger the GCP fallback lane.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Sonia
Director of Product, HelioHealth
